security_spec.violation_condition: The Linux kernel (in S-mode) accesses stimecmp CSR based solely on the SSTC ISA extension being reported, without verifying that M-mode firmware has set menvcfg.STCE=1. When stimecmp hardware exists but STCE=0, stimecmp is not accessible to S-mode (accesses trap) and STIP is writable by M-mode rather than being a read-only reflection of the hardware stimecmp comparator output.
security_spec.summary: Kernel code paths in timer-riscv.c, suspend.c, and KVM vcpu_timer.c access stimecmp assuming SSTC implies hardware-managed STIP, but spec now requires menvcfg.STCE=1 for both stimecmp accessibility and STIP read-only behavior
